events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — GOMA Friday Nights
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Step into Olafur Eliasson's immersive multi-sensory art installations during GOMA's special Friday night openings. The evening combines gallery access with bespoke bars, live DJs, pop-up performances, and delicious bites — creating an artistically alive, social atmosphere where art, music, and conversation naturally blend.

events.title: Anywhere Festival — Week 3 (Multiple Venues)
events.location: Multiple Brisbane venues (Albion, Yeronga, Grange, Milton, West End, New Farm, Fortitude Valley, etc.)
events.description: Brisbane's experimental arts festival uses hidden backyards, ferries, driveways, and unexpected corners as stages. Week 3 features theatre in hedge mazes, circus in driveways, music in backyards, immersive experiences, and storytelling — hundreds of shows from emerging and established artists across non-traditional venues.

events.title: BrisScience: 'The Heat Is On — Growing Food in a Warmer World'
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.source: University of Queensland / The Gentle Thinkers Meetup
events.description: UQ's monthly BrisScience lecture series brings science out of the lab to the public. Dr Millicent Smith, Senior Lecturer in Crop Physiology, explores how we can grow enough food in a warming world using cutting-edge phenotyping tools and novel crop diversity. Accessible to all; no prior knowledge required.

events.title: Bands in Parks: Twilight Jazz by the River
events.location: Queensland Maritime Museum Park, South Brisbane
events.description: Free outdoor jazz performance by UQ Big Band at a beautiful riverside park near the Goodwill Bridge. Watch the sunset over the Brisbane River with fellow music lovers in an informal, social setting. Register via Eventbrite.

events.title: Platform 2026 — IMA Exhibition (Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, Seren Wagstaff)
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: IMA's annual Platform exhibition spotlights three Queensland emerging artists: Dean Ansell (multidisciplinary installations exploring Melanesian mythology), Spencer Harvie (surreal paintings blending digital and imagined imagery), and Seren Wagstaff (installation and performance). Free artist talks scheduled during the run.

events.title: Free Range 6: SCRAPS (Laura Hill) @ IMA
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: IMA's Free Range sound club features Laura Hill's SCRAPS — a 20-year Brisbane underground veteran's analogue synth-pop project blending club beats with keyboard pop. Intimate, experimental, and musically adventurous.

events.title: GOMA: Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Exhibition)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Exclusive Brisbane exhibition of Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson's major installations, photography, and sculpture. The exhibition explores how our senses shape our experience of the world — featuring seminal works like *Beauty* (rainbow veil) and *Riverbed* (immersive rocky landscape). Spans GOMA's entire ground floor.

events.title: 'Make A Scene' — Queensland Museum Free Exhibition
events.location: Queensland Museum Kurilpa, South Brisbane
events.description: Immersive free exhibition celebrating 1990s Australian queer culture — 35 years after decriminalisation of homosexuality. Features fashion, colour, camp, pop culture, and personal stories from Brisbane's underground nightclub and dance party scene. Culturally significant and historically rich.

events.title: Gentle Thinkers — Intellectual Dialogue Meetup
events.location: Various Brisbane CBD/inner-city venues
events.description: Regular Brisbane meetup for intellectually curious people interested in conversations about scientific, social, and political issues. Each session focuses on one topic; everyone contributes. Philosophy inspired by Bertrand Russell: 'Do not feel absolutely certain of anything.' Naturally attracts thoughtful, open-minded people.

events.title: Mariah the Scientist: Hearts Sold Separately Tour
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Atlanta R&B and neo-soul artist Mariah the Scientist brings her emotionally intense, atmospheric sound to Brisbane. A thoughtful, artistically ambitious performer with a devoted following among music lovers.

events.title: J.I.D — God Does Like World Tour
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Atlanta rapper J.I.D (relocated from Riverstage) is one of hip-hop's most compelling live performers. Intimate headline show in a dedicated music venue rather than a large stadium.

events.title: Genesis Owusu
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Ghanaian-Australian alt-soul and punk-funk artist Genesis Owusu is one of Australia's most electrifying live performers. Expect an intense, genre-defying show full of energy and artistic ambition.

events.title: Audrey Hobert — The Staircase To Stardom Tour
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Rising indie-pop singer-songwriter Audrey Hobert brings her cinematic, emotionally rich songwriting to Brisbane. Intimate, atmospheric gig in a dedicated music venue.

events.title: Jason Leong: In Laughing Memory
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Malaysian stand-up comedian Jason Leong brings sharp, observational humour to Brisbane in an intimate touring comedy show.

events.title: Black Bear Lodge — Live Music & Sunday Service
events.location: Black Bear Lodge, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Brisbane's favourite live music venue curates first dibs on touring acts and intimate EP sets. Sunday Service features free live performances from Queensland's best emerging acts — a casual, social vibe with musicians and music lovers.

events.title: QSO Concert Special: The Italian Job
events.location: QPAC Concert Hall, South Brisbane
events.description: Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs an Italian-themed program featuring Rossini, Rota, Verdi, and Vivaldi arrangements. A celebratory orchestral evening by one of Australia's leading orchestras.

events.title: Weaving is Healing Brisbane
events.location: Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens
events.description: Figure-8 coil weave workshop with roots in African and European traditions. Participants weave a small basket in a ceremony-style immersive sharing and healing circle. Hands-on, creative, and community-oriented in a beautiful outdoor botanical setting.

events.title: Brisbane Makerspace — Monday Open Night
events.location: Brisbane Makerspace, Fortitude Valley area
events.description: Free public open night at Brisbane's community makerspace. Access to laser cutting, 3D printing, electronics, and arts & crafts tools. Recurring event to meet makers, learn, and collaborate — no membership required for public meetups.

events.title: HSBC German Film Festival @ Palace Cinemas
events.location: Palace Barracks (Petrie Terrace) & Palace Centro (James Street, New Farm)
events.description: 2026 HSBC German Film Festival showcases the best contemporary German cinema, plus selections from Austria and Switzerland. Palace Cinemas specializes in high-quality international art-house films — an ideal week for conversation-starting European cinema.

events.title: Brisbane International Film Festival (BIFF) — Screenings with Q&As
events.location: New Farm Cinemas, Palace Barracks, Dendy venues, Brisbane
events.description: BIFF screenings include Queensland premieres with post-screening Q&As with directors and filmmakers. Ideal for intellectually engaged film lovers seeking conversation-starting cinema and artistic community.

events.title: Avid Reader Open Book Club
events.location: Avid Reader, West End
events.description: Avid Reader's Open Book Club is the first Wednesday evening or Thursday morning of each month — ideal for newcomers. Recurring community of readers and thoughtful people. The bookshop also hosts author talks and runs themed clubs (Bloody Crime, Young & Restless, Australian literature).

events.title: Brisbane Language Exchange — Friday Social
events.location: Brisbane City (check Eventbrite for venue)
events.description: Weekly casual gathering for people who want to practice foreign languages and meet curious, internationally-minded locals and expats. Natural conversation opportunity in a social, relaxed setting.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.location: Redlands Coast (approx. 30–40 mins from Brisbane CBD)
events.description: 10-day festival showcasing adventure activities and outdoor events across Redlands Coast — hiking, nature excursions, coastal activities, and community events. Ideal for adventurous, active social types and nature lovers.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane 2026
events.location: Brisbane Showgrounds, Bowen Hills
events.description: Queensland's biggest dog celebration returns. Hundreds of dogs, breed showcases, adoption zones, and a family-friendly, joyful community atmosphere. Unexpectedly warm and social — a place to meet fellow animal lovers and their furry companions.

events.title: Botanic Gardens Free Guided Walks
events.datetime: Multiple times throughout the week (check website)
events.location: Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens / City Botanic Gardens
events.description: Free volunteer-led guided walks through Brisbane's botanic gardens. No booking required for small groups. Meet fellow nature enthusiasts with a love for plants and outdoor exploration. Low-key, social, nature-focused.

events.title: Brisbane Photography Meetup — Photowalks
events.datetime: Multiple sessions throughout the week (check meetup page)
events.location: Various Brisbane locations
events.description: Laid-back, friendly group of photographers and videographers exploring Brisbane and surrounding areas while capturing moments and learning new skills. Regular photowalks, themed sessions, and creative opportunities — free to attend.

events.title: ADFAS Lecture: 'The World's Greatest Paintings — 200 Years of the National Gallery'
events.datetime: Wed 14 May, 7:30 PM | Thu 15 May, 10:00 AM
events.location: Royal Queensland Art Society (Wed) / State Library of Queensland Auditorium 1 (Thu)
events.description: Lecturer Simon Whitehouse explores the National Gallery's 200-year history (1824–present), including early suffragette sabotage, bombs, theft, and the story of the original 'Angerstein 38' paintings. Intellectually engaging art history lecture for curious audiences.

events.title: Kids Tour: Presence & Play (Family Art Tour @ GOMA)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Multi-sensory art tour of Olafur Eliasson's Presence designed for families with children. Guided through playful experiences that spark imagination and build connection, followed by exclusive crowd-free exhibition viewing.

events.title: Inspiring Future Skills Symposium 2026 — Brisbane
events.location: QUT Kelvin Grove Campus, Kelvin Grove
events.description: Teacher-focused (but open to anyone interested in technology and education) professional learning on embedding future skills — AI, big data, quantum computing, robotics, augmented reality — into teaching and learning. Brings together education leaders, curriculum innovators, and industry experts.

events.title: Vertigo Rooftop Dining — Brisbane Powerhouse
events.datetime: Thu 14 May – Sun 17 May (6:30–9:00 PM Thu–Sat, 5:30–8:00 PM Sun)
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse Rooftop, New Farm
events.description: High-adventure dining experience: guests don safety harnesses, climb to rooftop seats with 17-metre drops beneath them, and enjoy a locally sourced meal from Bar Alto. Option to descend via rope dropline down the building's façade. Uniquely Brisbane and genuinely memorable.

events.title: Double Take — Australian Cinémathèque Film Program
events.location: Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: Curated cinema program at GOMA's Cinémathèque — a fixture for film lovers seeking thoughtful, artistically selected screenings in an intimate gallery cinema setting.

events.title: MJ The Musical
events.datetime: Multiple shows throughout the week until 24 May
events.location: Lyric Theatre, QPAC, South Brisbane
events.description: Olivier and four-time Tony Award-winning musical set in 1992, offering a behind-the-scenes look at Michael Jackson's Dangerous World Tour creation through an MTV journalist's lens. Genuinely spectacular live performance experience.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Multiple Shows
events.datetime: Throughout the week (24 April – 24 May, peak performances this week)
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse (New Farm), The Tivoli, Fortitude Music Hall, The Princess Theatre (Woolloongabba)
events.description: City-wide comedy festival featuring bold solo shows, late-night performances, and genre-bending acts — from satire and silliness to big-hearted storytelling. Browse individual shows for intimate solo performances at smaller venues.
